page: Microsoft Azure DC8as_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCasv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and features 8 dedicated vCPUs. The system is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning it relies entirely on external storage solutions, though it is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are no bundled GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio provide a stable resource profile for workloads requiring predictable performance without the overhead of local storage hardware.

Given its 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio and dedicated compute resources, the DC8as_v6 is suited for general-purpose workloads, mid-tier database hosting, application servers, and containerized deployments that require consistent CPU performance and moderate memory capacity.
